evidence_basis: New question outside prior coverage: is there any Rosa26-tdTomato reporter panel, and what do Supplementary Fig 1C and 1D show for the Synapsin-Cre S-KO. Read this session: Methods and Results passages on the conditional lines (held print text), the supplementary legends of File009, and Supplementary Fig 1 on page 7 of File009, rendered with pdftoppm at 150 and 400 dpi and viewed as images with the Read tool. The coverage vocabulary has no partial value, so figures and supplementary stay captions_only: figure images were viewed ONLY for the panels of Supplementary Fig 1 (A to F, page 7); every other main and supplementary figure image was not viewed in this delta. Earlier receipts, including one with figures read (FTR-20261003-33914858-03), are not erased by this one.

verbatim_locator | proposition: the reporter allele is stated once, in Methods, and is not shown in a panel I viewed | Methods | "All conditional models contained the Rosa26-loxp-STOP-tdTomato reporter allele."

verbatim_locator | proposition: the S-KO cortical WWOX loss is marked on arrowed neurons of one representative field | Supplementary Fig 1 legend, C | "showing loss of WWOX expression (shown with white arrows) in neurons of S-KO brain compared to S-Control at P17."

verbatim_locator | proposition: WWOX is reported intact in CC1-positive cells of S-KO corpus callosum | Supplementary Fig 1 legend, D | "Intact levels of WWOX are maintained in oligodendrocytes (stained with CC1) in S-KO compared to SControl at P17."
verbatim_locator | proposition: the Cre line stock is the same as in the independent characterisation | Methods | "Synapsin I-Cre [Stock: 003966, B6.Cg-Tg(Syn1-cre)671Jxm/J]"

Image observations (viewed): panel C, S-KO WWOX channel, at least two NeuN-positive cells at the lower left carry visible signal and are not arrowed; panel D, WWOX signal in CC1-positive cells in both genotypes; panels E and F are Olig2-Cre and GFAP-Cre controls; panels A and B are Nestin-Cre. No S-KO astrocyte or parvalbumin panel. One field per panel, n of animals and of cells not stated, no counts. Not seeing a tdTomato panel is not evidence that none exists in unviewed images.

Text-layer search for tomato, Rosa26 and reporter over the print text, the browser-print text and File009, and over the shared strings of three xlsx supplements, found the reporter only in the Methods sentence.
